tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma drug cu'i lag len la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'khrul med lam ston bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra bhai ra wā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro rgyal ma he'i zhal/ /dbyer med bla ma mchog la gus btud nas/ /gang gi gtor chog lag len bshad kyis nyon/ /de la 'dir bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung las/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos kyi tshul/ /sems can khams bzhin bgrang yas las/ /theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags/ /de yi snying po rdo rje'i theg /gsang sngags rgya mtsho thams cad las/ /las kun bde blag sgrub byed cing / /gdug pa 'dul byed drag po yi/ /las la gshin rje gshed po bsngags/ /de yi tshul yang dpag yas las/ /ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ /khyad par 'phags zhes lung las 'byung / /gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la snang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can gyi khams dang mthun par rgyal bas chos tshul mtha' yas gsungs pa bsdu na/ mdo sngags gnyis las sngags kyi theg pa la rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas/ bla med la thabs shes gnyis med rgyud gsum las/ 'dir thabs rgyud/ de la dug gsum gyi gnyen po rgyud gsum las/ 'dir zhe sdang can 'dul ba gshin rje gshed skor gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'di la 'phags bod du mkhas grub kyi lugs srol rnam grangs mang yang / de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'phags yul gyi slob dpon la li ta badzra nas nye bar brgyud de mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa la bka' babs cing / lo chen de nyid kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i lugs srol 'di la yang / bod kyi bla ma rnams kyi bzhed tshul mang yang / 'dir rwa 'bum seng nas klog skya dbang phyug grags la brgyud pa/ ldong ston shes rab dpal las bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches gsan te/

de dag dang mthun pa'i sgrub thabs sogs yig cha mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'phrin las char 'bebs dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba dang / zur 'debs bsnyen sgrub rnam rol/ zhar byung las gshin bcu gsum ma'i gtor chog bcas mdzad pa rnams gung bsgrigs nas/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen por phyag len du mdzad pa bzhin ngor lugs dgon sde gzhan du'ang cung zad 'phel zhing / rang re'i gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid na'ang dus phyis de'i lugs dar 'dug kyang / bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ tshig kyang sgrig legs mi shes na/ /don bzang smos kyang ci dgos pa'i/ /blun po rnams kyi rang ga'i tshig /mkhas rnams bzhad gad bskyed pa'i tshig /'brel med sna tshogs bris pa la/ /bstan bcos yin zhes nyan bshad byed/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i lung don thog babs lta bus/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog gi rim pa'i zhal 'don gyi man ngag ji lta ba blo gsal dga' ba'i dpal ster zhes bya ba mgo mjug med cing sus byas 'dis byas med pa'i yig rul nor ma nyes zhig gi steng nas go rim du ma nor 'gro ba zhig gtong gis 'dug kyang / sngar phan sus kyang gleng brjod ma byung / nged rang nas thar rtse rdo rje 'chang dang / 'jam mgon gnas gsar ba chen po sogs bla ma kha shas las rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lung man ngag 'khrid rgyun rnam dag rnams/ snyigs dus 'dir chos rgyun ma chad pa phal cher thos shing / rang nyid kyis kyang yig cha rnams la lta rtogs mi dman tsam dang khyad par ngor chen yab sras kyi gsung la chung ngu nas goms 'dris che bar ma zad/ ngor lugs yig cha rnams shin tu zhal gsal zhing rtogs sla bas na/ de dag dang gong gi yig rul de gnyis lag len 'don cha gnyis ka rgyab 'gal du song ba lta bus shin tu khungs ma dag par mthong nas/

nged rang lo bco brgyad tsam la nye ba'i skabs shig bzo 'dun yod kyang rim 'gyangs su lus mthar lcags sbrul dang / chu rta lor ngor chen yab sras kyi yig cha de dag nag 'gros bklag chog ma zhig mdar grang chen mkhan po zhal dkar rje drung ngag dbang shes rab la gsung rtsom bskul ma zhus don bzhin mdzad pa'i yi ge de sor bzhag ma 'thus pa rnams nged rang nas zur 'debs nyung ngur bkod pa 'di thog nas lag len bgyis tshe cho ga shin tu dag par 'gyur ba ni/ mkhas grub thugs gzu bor gnas pa rnams kyis gzigs gsal ltar lags pas/ des na 'dir sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phyag len dang mthun par nyams su len tshul ni/ thog mar 'di'i rdo rje slob dpon 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi chos skor rnams thob pa'i gang zag gis/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed bsnyen yig dang / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg zhal dkar bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg de dang thar rtse bas mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig de gnyis nged rang nas lhan cig sdeb bsgrigs kyi yi ge khro rgyal dgongs rgyan rnams kyis steng nas gzhi bsnyen bcu cha'i sbyin bsreg dang bcas pa mthar phyin dang / gtor bzlog sngon 'gro'i kha gso'i bsnyen pa'ang rgyas bsdus sna tshogs skabs bstun bya/ sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i rnam bshad bdud rtsi'i nying khu dang / drug cu rnam bshad nor bu'i phreng ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa la lta rtog bya/ bshom gyi skabs su gzhan rnams phrin las tsha zer bzhin la/ sa lo'i phyag len la dam rdzas bcu tshar nas gsum gyi bar gang rung re rgyun gyi gtor bsngo'i gtor mar mdzad pa'i phyag len yod pas/ 'dir stegs bang rim gsum pa ras sogs kyis bkab cing 'bru sna tshogs bkram pa'i dang por 'jigs byed gtor ma/

gnyis par rgyun gyi gtor bsngo'i gtor ma dam rdzas lnga/ gsum par rgyun bskang gi gtor ma bkram bskang / de dag gi mdun du mgyogs gtor las gshin dang / phyogs skyong la gru gsum zur rtse rno ba khrag gis dmar por byugs shing rgyan dang mtheb kyu med pa mdung dar nag po btsugs pa khru gang ba re re/ rgyun gyi thun gtor phud chang bcas/ 'jigs byed gtor ma'i mdun du drag mchod lnga dang / bkram bskang gi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod bshams/ mgyogs gtor gyi mdun la yang drag mchod bshams na legs/ drag mchod kyi gras la sha lnga'i gzugs ma bzos kyang chog slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru 'thor nas rnams bshams mo/ cho ga'i rim pa la/ mchod pa byin rlabs rnga rol 'bud dkrol bcas/ skyabs yul rnams gsal btab/ zhes pa 'dir rgyas par na 'khrid gzhung ltar dang / bsdu na sa los rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed du skyabs yul rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dge 'dun sogs yin par gsungs pa bzhin 'dir yang 'dra bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi bdud bzhi gdong drug nad gdon rnams kyi steng rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa/ phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ de nyid kyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas su mos/ bdag dang rigs drug gi sems can rnams nas/ 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyis kun nas bslang ste/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ skyabs sems kyi ngag 'don rnams kyai rdor lam dus kyi dbu sor bzhag rdor sems bsgom bzlas 'phrin las tsha zer sor bzhag las/ 'di nas 'di bar e waṃ du ngag 'don la mi mdzad zer ba 'di yang sa skyar 'don srol yod pas bton la/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur zhes dang yig brgya bzla ba sogs byas nas/

shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur par bya/ rang skad cig gis zhes sogs nas/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥbar bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod bzhin la/ oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ'i bar phyag rgya bcas bya/ bcom ldan de bzhin sogs nas dbu brgyan bar dkyus bzhin/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥnas/ ghaṇḍe hoḥbar/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i nas/ hūm̐ gis mtshan bar/ hrīḥṣṭīḥlan re brjod pa dang bstun rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya dpral mgrin snying khar reg bdud rtsi myang ba mchod bstod rnams gzhung bzhin byas mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ gi rjes su bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la sems gtad nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag thugs ka'i sngags 'khor gsal 'debs 'di ngag nas brjod pa legs pas/ de'i tshul ni dkyus su mi gsal ba/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ de'i thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar khro bo'i rdo rje nas/ kha dog sngon po'i bar dkyus bzhin/ de rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas/ skye 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus/ dgra gegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ las bzhi'i dmigs pa 'di 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung la nged rang nas cung zad bcos pa yin/ phreng ba bsangs sbyangs sogs nas/ gri thod 'dzin pa'i skur gyur bar dkyus bzhin/ phreng ba thal mo gnyis kyi bar du phur la/

hrīḥṣṭiḥlan gsum bzlas nas ha btab/ bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod na go rim bzhin 'dug kyang / dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bsnyen sgrub rnam rol las phreng ba byin rlabs sngon dang / thugs ka'i sngags 'khor rjes la gsungs pas de bzhin stabs bde/ gang ltar yang sngags rnams las rtsa sngags dang snying po lnga brgya/ nye snying stong phrag re bzla/ bzlas pa tshugs pa dang mchod dpon gyis gtor ma tshang ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug bde bar gshegs pa nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar dkyus bzhin/ kyai rdor bskyed rim rnam bshad rnams na mi gsal yang lam dus kyi bzlas pa bsdus nas yig brgya lan gsum bzla ba sa lo'i phyag len la yod pa bzhin/ 'dir yang dkyil 'khor bsdu gong du yig brgya bzla bar ma bshad kyang / rdor sems yig brgya lan gsum bzlas na 'brel chags par sems/ dkyil 'khor bsdu skabs gzhan dkyus bzhin las/ 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ zhes brjod pa'i rjes su/ bsrung 'khor mi bsdu bar/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la thim/ zhes sogs dang sbrel/ de nas gtor ma gang yod nang mchod ltar byin rlabs byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las padma zhes sogs dkyus bzhin la/ slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ de nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur pa ni zhes dang / gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de la thim bzhin yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes dang / de nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni zhes bdag mdun gyi tshig mi 'dra ba'i khyad sbyar/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po nas/ yid kun tu bzang po/ zhes pa'i bar gyis skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las nas/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang /

bcom dung bcom rol mgon po'i bswo ring lugs la gnyis brdeg len can rkang gling bcas/ 'jam khros shlau ka gcig la dbyangs bswo ring / nyis brdeg len can/ tshur byon shlau ka gcig la de'i bu dbyangs nyis brdeg len can/ chems brdung gi bar la sngags bzla rol mo so so'i rkang gling 'bud mtshams kyang phyag len bzhin g.yab dar dang bcas/ mjug gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ rnga rol gzhan bzhag nas oṃ badzra lā sye nas/ ghandhe āḥbar phyag rgya bcas/ bcom ldan de bzhin sogs nas khyod kyi 'di la dbang bskur stsol zhes dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi sogs nas/ gaṇḍe hoḥbar/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bar bdag bskyed bzhin la tshig zur cung zad bsgyur ba/ hrīḥṣṭiḥlan gsum bzlas nas rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya de mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum du bzhag tshul byas la/ 'das gtor 'bul sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos/ stong gsum ma'i 'gor mchod pa byin rlabs med pa ni gong gi gnas yo byin rlabs des 'thus par mdzad pa phyag len bsdus pa'i lugs so/ /bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg len can lugs rkang gling bcas/ stong gsum ma'i bcom rol dang / shapta'i chems brdung la rkang gling 'bud rol tshig gzhan la mi 'bud/ stong gsum ma shlau ka gcig la mgon po 'khor dang ma'i rang dbyangs rol mo bcas/ bcom ldan rdo rje zhes sogs nas 'dur gdangs/ grub par mdzod kyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can/ bsdus pa'i mthar chems brdung gi bar la sngags bzla zhing / slob dpon pad skor sngon 'gro'i mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya bca'/ chems brdung sngags bcas rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar la rigs 'gre/ badzra puṣpe zhes yod pa'i badzra 'di de phyin thams cad la sbyor dgos rgyu yin/

rkang dung gling bu zhes sogs la rkang gling 'bud tshul mgon po 'khor dang ma bzhin/ shapta'i chems brdung la slob dpon gyi dril bu bsil/ rkang gling sgang dung dharma ra ṇi tshar gcig las mi brjod/ g.yang gzhi bla re 'dur gdangs sngags kyang rnga brdung ba'i mu la brjod la/ pra tītstsha swāhā'i rjes su gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ 'di la lda ldi bri ba'i phyag rgya mdzad srol sa lo'i phyag len la med de/ sa skyar mgon po'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod skabs/ g.yang gzhi bla re la phyag rgya med do/ /nang mchod byin rlabs bsdus pa'i go chod mdzad pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs su rgyas pa song ba la dgongs pas bdud rtsi 'bul tshul g.yang gzhi bla re sogs rdzogs nas rnga rol bzhag nas/ 'bru gsum lan gnyis brjod pa'i dang po la thod chang bdud rtsir dran tsam dang / gnyis pa la de nas mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ de nas rnga brdung shlau ka gcig la gser skyems kyi dbyangs rol dang bcas pas/ rdo rje 'chang dang sogs nas/ rdo rje grags dang sogs nas 'dur gdangs/ dngos grub stsol gyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ gzhan yang zab cing rgya che ba'i/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag rnams/ /stsol mdzad bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ /myong byed stong gi sogs 'dur gdangs/ /'di'i skabs su phrin las tsha zer na/ /zhes pa man dang / a mṛ tas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs la 'bul gsungs pa 'di/ de 'phros stong gsum ma dang cha 'dra byed dgos yin pas/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / zhes pa'i rjes su/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi nas/ sa pa ri wā ra'i bar stong gsum ma bzhin la/ a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sbyar la gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/

gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi yi lha sogs 'dur gdangs/ sdong grogs mdzod kyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ 'di rnams la rol mo len pa dang bstun slob dpon gyi bdud rtsi re 'thor/ sdong grogs mdzod kyi rol mo la bdud rtsi gtor nas/ slar yang rang gi lce la myangs/ 'di skabs 'phrin las tsha zer nas gsungs pa'i tshigs lhug rnams mi brjod pa ni sa lo'i phyag len phal cher la dpon slob bsgrigs 'don mdzad pa shas che bas so/ /gzugs sgra la sogs nas/ chags par mdzod kyi bar 'dur gdangs gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa'i mthar nyis brdeg len can 'phar ma blangs la/ mi thung sgeg pa shlau ka gcig la gur mgon srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs nyis brdeg len can zla ba bzhin du nas 'dur gdangs/ glang lpags rdzogs nas/ gnyis med sbyor ba khyod phyag 'tshal la gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ dang po'i g.yas na nas/ 'dur gdangs/ de ltar 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal la gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ g.yon gyi nas 'dur gdangs/ de ltar 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal la gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ dur khrod rgyan gyi nas 'dur gdangs/ ma he'i zhal la bdag phyag 'tshal la/ tshig rol gyi mthar sbraṃ mi the ba'i gcig gnyis gsum/ bdun brdung gsum/ che gcig hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar la/ 'jam khros ma la mgon po'i drag bskul 'das dang ma'i 'dur gdangs bcas/ dkyil 'khor te'i rjes su sbraṃ sbraṃ mi the ba'i bdun brdung gcig bdun brdung rkyang pa gnyis che gcig 'jam dpal khros pa nas/ rngam pas mnan pa ma he rwa bar dal/ brdar bas ri rab nas brel/ ma lus dgra bgegs myur du zo'i rjes su/ sbraṃ sbraṃ mi the ba'i bdun brdung gcig bdun rkyang pa gnyis/ che gcig 'di skabs phrin las tsha zer las/ /'phro 'du 'khyil ba khro mo'i rgyan/ /zhes pa 'di lan gnyis 'don dgos par gsungs pa sogs 'og nas kyang gnyis gsum 'dab dgos yod pa rnams kyang gcig gis chog

rdo rje khro bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhes sogs la dbyangs gong bzhin dang / dbyangs dang bstun pa'i rol mo che rgyag chung rgyag spel ma ste theng brdung yin 'di la dung chen mi 'bud/ sdang ba'i dgra dang zhes sogs nas/ rnga phyir brdung gdangs brel du btang la/ rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis/ zhes pa'i rjes su bdun brdung byed tshul gong bzhin dung chen bcas kyi mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas la rnga rol bzhag de nas rang re'i gdan sa 'dir gtor bsngo chen mo dang / bskang ba rgyas bsdus gang rung re sgrub mchod gtor bzlog mdzad kyang de gras la stabs gcig tu mdzad pa 'di sa lo'i phyag len la dar bas de bzhin bya zhing 'di skabs kyi dam rdzas gtor ma'i gral rim gyi ngos 'dzin kyang 'ol tshod tsam ma yin par ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi 'jig byed rwa lugs kyi dkyil chog rab gsal snang ba las/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das/ gnyis pa chos skyong / gsum pa phyogs skyong / bzhi pa las gshin/ lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi la phul nas/ zhes gsungs pas/ dang po bcom ldan 'das la 'bul rgyu de 'dir 'jigs byed la gtor ma zur pa bshams yod pas de nas 'das gtor 'bul yul bde kyai gnyis yin pas/ dam rdzas dang por byin rlabs dran ched oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pa byas la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e sogs kyai rdor gtor bsngo dang bde mchog gtor bsngo bya/ zlum gtor gnyis pa de gur zhal nas phur bsrung gi bar la yang yang byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul rgyu yin/ phur bsrung gtor bsngo rdzogs nas/ zlum gtor gsum pa dang / mgyogs gtor g.yas pa stabs gcig tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ phyag rgya bcas lan gcig dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gnyis kyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas sogs dkyus bzhin la bkug par gyur zhes dang hrīḥṣṭiḥyongs rdzogs kyi mthar ind+ra duṣṭan sogs sbyar ba lan gcig

phyogs skyong rnams zhes pa nas phur bus btab bar dkyus bzhin/ de nas phur bu 'debs tshul dang bcas/ oṃ ind+ra badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mā ya badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du phyogs skyong so so'i sngags kyi 'gor/ oṃ dang mjug tu badzra kī la ya sbyar ba 'di phur gdab kyi sngags rgyas pa yin/ bsdu na oṃ and+ri ya/ ya ma yā/ wa ru ṇā ya zhes sogs hrīḥṣṭiḥdang ma spel ba'i phyogs skyong gi sngags pri thi wi bhyaḥkyi badzra kī la ya btags pa yin kyang / snga ma dmigs pa gsal zhing phyag len la dar bas de bzhin bya/ gang ltar yang / spyi bo nas zhes sogs dkyus bzhin phyogs skyong gi gtor sngags 'di'i mjug la yi ge mang nyung sna tshogs zhig bla ma gong ma so so'i yig char yod 'dug kyang / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha na ha gsum/ hi gsum/ hūm̐ gsum/ phaiṃ gsum/ phaṭa gsum/ yod pa 'di ka yin/ gtor sngags 'di dus rgyun du'ang 'grub tshe drug cu rtsa bzhi brjod/ ma 'grub na grangs ci rigs yin/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang sogs kyi nang mchod/ bdud bzhi po ni sogs shlau ka gcig shur ma dril gsil bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg len can lugs/ hūm̐ gshin rje gshed kyi rnam sprul sogs shlau ka gcig la lha mchog nag po'i dbyangs dang gsum brdeg len can/ de phyin 'dur gdangs snying rje'i dgra bgegs la tshig rol dgu brdung rnga phyir bsgyur/ sdang ba'i dgra dang sogs/ rdul tsam yang la tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg len can byas la bzhag zlum gtor bzhi pa dang mgyogs gtor g.yon pa stabs cig tu phyogs skyong gi gtor ma byin brlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha'i khams su rlung nag zhes sogs kyus bzhin la/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ'i rjes su bcom dung bcom rol rkang gling bcas kyi rjes su gsum brdeg chung bzhi che bcu ste dgu brdeg len med yin/

hūm̐ 'di nas lho yi sogs shlau ka gcig dang / ma mo kun gyi sogs shlau ka gcig la pu tra'i spyan 'dren dad pa dam tshig ma'i dbyangs rol rkang gling bcas/ dge ba can gyi btang 'dzin pa nas 'dur ma/ dam tshig dbang gis bshegs su gsol la tshig rol gyi mthar chems brdung rkang gling g.yab dar bcas kyi skabs hrīḥṣṭīḥyongs rdzogs kyi mthar ya ma rā dza sogs dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbatags pa tshar gcig brjod la gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la rnga rol bzhag slar yang sogs dbang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra nai wi ti āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas dbu brgyan bar/ g.yas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba'i phyag rgya dang / hrīḥṣṭīḥyongs rdzogs kyi mthar/ ya mā nas satwaṃ bar/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje bsdams pa las srin lag gnyis lhan cig bsgreng ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ gzhan rnams kyis rnga brdung 'dur gdangs/ gshin rje'i rgyal po nas bzhugs su gsol gyi mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ chems brdung gi bar la sngags bzlas la gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa/ dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i sogs nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar la'ang rnga rol byed lugs de kha sor bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis mchod sngags so so'i mgor hrīḥṣṭīḥbazla skabs be con gyi phyag rgya dang / mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod sngags la pad kor mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya mjug tu se gol gtogs pa dang / shapta'i chems brdung la dril gsil rkang gling sgang dung / kha dog dri ro sogs gtor 'bul gyi mtha'i chems brdung la arghaṃ gyi gnas su ba lyaṃ di zhes pa 'di bcug la rdor thal kha gyen bstan gyi mthar se gol/ mchod sngags kyi pra tītstsha 'di arghaṃ gcig pu'i rjes la ma gtogs gzhan rnams la mi dgos/ de nas rnga rol bzhag la/ oṃ kā la ru pa sogs gtor sngags lan bdun gyi gtor ma 'bul skabs rdor thal kha gyen bstan dang /

se gol gtogs/ zlum gtor lnga pa 'di mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma thun mong yin pas byin brlabs sngon 'gro'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma gtor bsngo chen mo ltar phul la 'khon gcugs sbyangs ba'i yig brgya bdun/ chos skyong spyi'i mgo gnon kyai rdor de ba pi tsu gsum/ 'di las gshin gyi mgo gnon la'ang sbyar rung mod/ khul che ba'i phyir las gshin mgo gnon la dmigs nas hrīḥṣṭīḥphreng 'khor gcig yig brgya nas 'di bar shib bu/ mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma nas bzung phur bsrung gi bar rgyun bzhin gsum re 'ur 'don/ las gshin gyi yi ge bdun ma dang / yi ge bcu gcig la phreng 'khor re shib bu/ oṃ kā la ru pa sogs sngags tshan gnyis po 'di dang yum gyi sngags rnams so so nas nyer gcig re 'ur 'don bzlas la/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa sogs gcig sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ rdor dril sogs dkrol gyi yid mchod dang bstod thung byas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sogs rgyun gyi gtor bsngo'i bzlas gsham gyi phyi mchod nang mchod nas bzung / phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol gyi mthar/ bcom dung bcom rol nyis brdeg len can/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol shlau ka gcig la srin thung gi dbyangs nyis brdeg can/ ma mo kun gyi nas 'dur ma byas mthar/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod la chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas la bzhag de nas gtor bsngo'i bshags pa bya/ 'o na phyogs skyong las gshin 'di dag gur zhal gyi bskang gso'i sngon la song bas gong 'og 'chugs so snyam na skyon med de/ gur zhal gyi bskang gso'i sngon la gtor bsngo'i gzhi bdag gtor ma yod cing / yul so so'i gzhi bdag dbang thob pa rnams las kyang phyogs skyong dang las gshin dgongs pa mtho bar ma zad phyogs skyong las gshin gyi skor 'di gtor bsngo'i gras las bskang gso'i gras las mi 'gro ste/

'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi las gshin bskang ba'i gsham 'di la mkhas grub gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i mchod phreng tsam las bskang ba dngos su mi snang yang / bla ma arya de wa dpon slob kyi mchod phreng na mdos sogs kyi bshad pa dang / bskang gso nyung ngu zhig 'dug pa khungs su byas nas sbyar zhes gsungs pas/ bskang gso dang mchod phreng so so yin zhing / ngor chen yab sras kyi las gshin gtor bsngo la mchod phreng sbyor ba mdzad pa yin pas phyogs skyong las gshin gnyis gtor bsngo'i gras la bgrang ngo / /bskang rdzas byin brlabs/ bskang ba thugs dam shur ma/ bka' bsgo'i 'jug gi dgu brdung byas la/ rol mo bzhag la rnga phyir brdung 'dur shur gang rung gi hūm̐ 'jig rten 'das dang sogs/ dpang gzugs kyi mthar/ bdag gi ma nyes gzu dang dpang po mdzod la/ tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar gsum brdeg len can byas la/ las gshin bstod pa hūm̐ khams gsum sogs shlau ka gcig la dbyangs gang thugs ma thung ba gsum brdeg len can/ bskal pa me 'bar nas 'dur shur gang rung / rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la tshig rol dgu brdung / bcom ldan 'das chos rje sogs kyi mthar tshig rol gyi mthar sbraṃ mi the ba'i gsum brdeg gnyis/ 'then rkang gnyis/ dgu brdung 'then rkang gnyis/ che gcig hūm̐ ngā zhes sbyar la/ chos kyi rgyal po shlau ka gcig la chos nyid ma yi bzlog dbyangs/ rol mo gsum brdeg 'then rkang gnyis dgu brdung 'then rkang gnyis/ che gcig ya ba ti yang sogs nas 'dur shur gang rung / ral pa tshar dgu'i mthar bsgyur ro la tshig rol dgu brdung / kā la ra tri nas tsa munt+ri yang gi mthar/ bsgyur ro la tshig rol dgu brdung / ya ma da ti sogs nas/ ya ma daṃ ṣṭi'i mjug dgra bgegs thams cad la za bar gyis mthar bsgyur ro la tshig rol dgu brdung / rgya chen bzhi sogs kyi mthar bsgyur ro la tshig rol dgu brdung /

yas kyi bdud g.yos sogs nas/ bsgyur ro la tshig rol dgu brdung mthar chems brdung / bzlog dung / gsum brdeg len can/ bzlog pa 'di grangs gsog byed na/ dang po de la/ chos kyi rgyal po nas ma bzhi rdzogs mtshams kyi tshig rol dgu brdung dang / gying bzhi'i rjes su yas kyi bdud g.yos sogs yar blangs la tshig rol dgu brdung bya/ gnyis pa nas brgyad pa'i bar la chos kyi rgyal po nas/ skyag dang dgra gshed kyi mthar bsgyur ro la tshig rol dgu brdung gi bar la grangs bzung / dgu pa la gshed bzhi gying dang gying bzhi rdzogs mtshams kyi rol mo dang / rgyal chen bzhi sogs yongs rdzogs bya'o/ /sku rim chen mo'i skabs bzlog bsdus brgyad dang / yongs rdzogs tshar gcig bcas dgu/ gang ltar mgon po lcam dral dang zhal gyi sngags dbyangs nas bzung / rdor glu/ bkra shis smon lam rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ dpon slob rnams zhwa gyon nas langs/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas rol mo dkrol skabs dril bu gsil/ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po sogs la/ chos nyid ma'i dbyangs dang bcas/ 'os pa yin dang / bsrung ma khyod dang / mi bsrungs te dang / las 'di rnams dang / snying la bzhag dang / ma sgrub na dang / de bas las 'di sgrub par gyis zhes shlau ka re re dang / shlau ka phyed dang gnyis rnams kyi mthar rol mo gsum brdeg 'then rkang dgu brdung sogs gong bzhin/ dgu brdung tshugs pa dang bstun dung chen phra ngar gdangs gcig ma re byed/ sa 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre/ khyod kyi 'khor gyi zhes sogs la'ang dbyangs 'di bcug la 'dzin par byed kyi rjes su wā ya ra rol mo blangs te/ khyed la gnyer du gtad pa nas/ bzung bar gyis bar la dbyangs dang bstun pa'i 'then brdung mthar gsum brdeg theng rkang dgu brdung sogs dbyangs rol 'di bzhin las gtad yongs rdzogs la rigs 'gre theng brdung rnams la dung chen mi 'bud/

gsum brdeg sogs tshugs nas 'bud/ gtsigs pa tsam gyi za bar byed rdzogs nas rol mo theng brdung skabs mchod dpon gyi gtor 'khur ba la thog mar las gshin dang / de nas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma gtad la phyir 'khyer/ de'i rjes su rkang gling pa gnyis g.yab dar dang bcas pa mtshams mtshams su rkang gling 'bud cing gtor 'khur ba'i 'gab la g.yab ste sgrub khang nas gom pa zhe dgu las mi nye ba'am/ shin tu thag ring bar skyel thub na de bas kyang legs pas gang ltar na'ang gtor ma drang por zur skyel phyogs la bstan te bzhag ba dan dang gtor snod bsdus/ rkang gling pa gnyis kyis g.yab dar sa la brdeb pa'am brdeb tshul bya/ mgyogs gtor ba phyir song ba'i skabs dpon slob rnams kyi gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor sogs bskul gyi phros byas la mthar chems brdung gi skabs hrīḥṣṭīḥbazla zhing drag dung / gsum brdeg len can byas nas stan la bzhugs/ rgyun bskang gtor 'bul srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma sogs bya/ zhwa phud/ nyin dang po rnams la mchod bstod mi dgos pas thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sogs dngos grub blangs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum/ nongs bshags brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol rnams gtor bsngo chen mo'i mjug bzhin gyis 'thus/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po nas/ yid kun tu bzang po'i bar dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag sogs/ khro bo 'bar ba'i sogs/ bgegs dang log par sogs/ de las byung ba'i sogs/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig nas/ de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog bar/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas sogs nas/ ji ltar bsngos pa 'grub par shog bar rgyun bzhin/ zhwa gyon dril gsil kyai rdor bkra shis kyi gdangs bcas/ 'khor lo'i mgon po sogs bkra shis shlau ka lnga byas la bskul mtshams nor gyi dbang phyug nas bskul la/ mjug rgyun bzhin no/

/des nyin dang po rnams kyi chog khrigs yongs rdzogs bstan zin to/ /gtor ma 'phen nyin dkyil 'khor dang bshoms rnams phrin las tsha zer sor bzhag la/ gtor nang du 'jug rgyu'i liṅga ni mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi 'jigs byed drug cu'i go don las bris ling rung bar gsungs shing / bri rdzas ni dgra nag gi rgyud las/ smyo byed kyi ni khu ba dang / zhes pa ltar/ ske tshe tshwa btsan dug nim pa zhes pa dbyi mong sga pho ril pi ling mar nag la tsha ba gsum gyi khu ba bsdus pas tsha ba'i mar du 'gro/ dur sol byung na dam nyams kyi ro sol dgos/ smyo byed zhes pa thang khrom ma'i 'bras bu bsres pas/ snag tshas dug shog la liṅga mtho gang pa rid cing bu ga rnams nas khrag 'dzag pa/ lag gnyis rgyab tu zhags nag gis bsdams shing / rkang pa lcags sgrog gis bcings pa'i dpral bar rus/ snying khar ming / 'doms su tsha bris pa de lcags mkhar gyi dbus su mgo gsham ldog nas mdun slob dpon ngos la bstan te bcug pa'i srub thams cad sha khrag shin tu rlon pa dang sgog rdog drug cu re bzhis 'geng / gtor bshoms kyi skabs su zan leb gcig lhag pa steng nas 'gebs byed la bsre zhes pa 'di zan lhag de bsres pa'i gtor ma gru gsum zur rtse rno ba gsham gyis lcags mkhar gyi zur gsum khebs pa zhig bcos la steng nas bkab bo/ /ngag 'don gyi rim pa mchod pa byin brlabs nas bzung / bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus ba'i bar nyin snga ma rnams sor bzhag de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor ya manta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las sogs nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs bar phrin las tsha zer bzhin gyi gtso bo bskyed/ de'i thugs ka nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhes sogs nas/ a karṣa ya dzaḥbar nyin dang po rnams kyi phyogs skyong gtor bsngo'i skabs bzhin/ phyogs skyong rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi phyogs mtshams steng 'og rnams su 'khod pa ni/

shar du brgya byin sogs nas 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba zhes pa'i bar gyi gsal btab/ khro bo rnams rang la thim/ slar yang rang gi snying kha sogs phur gdab byas la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur bar bya/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs nas yid kun tu bzang po bar/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las zhes pa'i bar nyin snga ma rnams sor bzhag la gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du oṃ badzra aṅku sha sogs gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bar hrīḥṣṭīḥlan gsum gyi phyag rgya gtugs pa rnams bya/ de nas dpon slob thams cad langs nas zhwa gyon/ slob dpon gyi rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya lcags mkhar la bstan la/ dzaḥrje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes sogs dgug gzhug gzhung bzhin bskul la/ dam nyams sdig can thams cad dgra bgegs kyi liṅga 'di nyid la myur du mchis par gyur cig zhes dang drag rol bya zhing / mchod dpon gyis lcags mkhar la gu gul bdug slob dpon gyis lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs rnams kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha sogs sngags gsum dang / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ'i tshe dril bu gsil hrīḥṣṭīḥci rigs bzla zhing dmigs pa bya/ bkug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams lcags mkhar gyi nang gi bris ling la thim par bsam/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byas pa'i rjes mar slob dpon gyi rdor dril thogs nas 'chams tshul dang / sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ bdun brdung gsum che gcig hūm̐ ngo zhes sbyar la/ zhe sdang gis mnan la 'das dang ma'i gdangs las mdzod cig gi rjes su sbraṃ mi the ba'i bdun brdung sogs 'jam khros ma bzhin/

slob dpon gyi rdor dril bzhag la lcags kyu thogs hūm̐ dzaḥgaza' bzhin sogs la dbyangs gong bzhin dang / khug cig badzra aṅku sha'i tshe slob dpon gyis lcags kyu bskor nas gtor nang gi liṅga la 'gug tshul/ de bzhin du zhags pa'i sne gnyis nas g.yas g.yon khu tshur gyis bzung la/ chings shig zhes pa'i tshe khu tshur bskor nas mthar kha phub kyi 'chings tshul/ lcags sgrog la'ang zhags pa dang 'dra ba las khu tshur kha gyen bstan/ dril bu la g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dril bu gsil/ tho ba dang dgra satwa gnyis kyi brdung tshul dang gshog tshul 'dra/ rtse gsum gyi rtse phar bstan te cung zad gsor/ phur bu lag pa gnyis kyi sgril tsam dang / g.yas kyi 'debs tshul/ ral gris gshog tshul rnams byas nas/ kharga hoḥ'i mthar rol mo gong bzhin dang / rdor dril thogs pa'i 'chams tshul dang / mthar chems brdung gi rdo rje snying gar bzung / dril bu dkrol la rnam shes spor dmigs dang / rnam par mi rtog sogs slob dpon gyi ngag nas brjod kyang rung rnam shes hūm̐ yig de la mchod par bsam la/ rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas nyer mchod lnga'i phyag rgya dang / puṣpe nas nai wi dye'i bar brjod/ hūm̐ de 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me tog gi char bcas nam mkhar je mtho je mthor gshegs nas 'og min longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs kar thim par bsam la mig gyen du gtad nas mnyam par bzhag bsgral mchod kyi phyag mtshan 'di rnams mchod dpon gyi slob dpon la rim gyi 'bul len bya/ de nas rol mo gsum brdeg len can byas la rnga rol bzhag zhwa phud stan la 'khod/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag sogs mchod par phul ba yin pas/ stong gsum ma'i 'gor mchod pa byin brlabs bya/ stong gsum ma nas/ ma he'i zhal la bdag phyag 'tshal bar nyin snga ma rnams sor bzhag la tshig rol gyi mthar gsum brdeg byas nas rnga rol bzhag 'di skabs su gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi yi lha zhes sogs tshugs pa dang bstun mchod dpon gyis mchod gtor rgyag gtor thams cad la sbyangs bdug bya/

bzlas pa'i skabs su bya mi dgos/ gtor ma rnams oṃ ya manta ka sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi zhes sogs gtor ma byin brlabs sngags gsum gyi gtor 'bul/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa gcig sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ ā hūm̐ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ bar gyi phyi mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil gyi/ gzugs sgra sogs yid mchod/ dur khrod rgyan gyi nas/ dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod kyi bar gyi bstod thung rnams byas la/ rol mo bcom nas bdun brdung byed tshul dgug gzhug rjes ma bzhin/ 'jam khros ma gtong tshul gong bzhin/ kyai rdor gtor bsngo nas phur srung gtor bsngo'i bar/ de nas gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi bya ba ni/ zhwa gyon/ mchod dpon gyis lcags mkhar gyi steng gi gtor ma de bsal snod cig tu bzhag lcags mkhar gyi mdun du gtor thebs gnyis su sha hrug dang / mtheb kyu gsum re blugs/ gzhan yang bza' btung sna tshogs lug ru/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ dpon slob rnams kyis gtor thebs dang po de nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phyogs skyong gi gtor sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / rdor 'dzin dril gsil gur drag bzhin gyi mchod rol sgang dung / bdud bzhi po ni sogs shlau ka gcig gi bstod pa rnams kyi tshe mchod dpon gyis gtor thebs dang po lcags mkhar du blugs la/ yang sha thebs bshams la sbyangs bdug gtor thebs gnyis pa nas nyi shu pa'i bar la byin brlabs bsdus pa gzhung bzhin las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥphyag rgya dang bcas lan gcig dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gnyis/

'bul sngags nas bstod pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis gtor thebs gnyis 'bul res byas la nyi shu'i bar grangs bzung / nyi shu rtsa gcig pa der sha dang mtheb kyu bzhi blug 'bul sngags tshar bzhi'i bsngo ba las gzhan 'dra/ de rdzogs pa dang sngar gyi gtor ma de lcags mkhar gyi steng du sbyar/ mdung nag sogs btsugs/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbran/ dpon slob rnams kyis rol mo gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas la/ phyogs skyong gi phrin bskul gong bzhin byas nas/ zhwa phud las gshin gtor bsngo nas bzung / rgyun bskang gi bka' bsgo rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ dpang gzugs dang las gshin gyi bstod bskul bzlog pa rnams mi dgos pas bka' bsgo'i dgu brdung gi mthar chems brdung bzlog dung / sngags dbyangs bstod pa sogs byas la/ phur bsrung gi bstod mjug gsum brdeg len can byas nas/ rdor glu bkra shis smon lam rnams byas la/ mchod dpon gyis bzlog dkyil drag mchod lcags mkhar gyi mthar spungs/ snod rnams khrag sogs kyi rjes med par kha phub tu bzhag slob dpon dang 'bag gyon mi chas su gzhug slob dpon gyis rdor dril thogs/ 'bag pas gri gug bandha/ dpon slob thams cad zhwa gyon langs nas/ rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar bcas bcom la gsum brdeg len can dang bstun pa'i 'chams khams gsum sems can sogs nas/ re ba'i sems kyis 'dud cing mchis/ bar gyi rnga rol dbyangs rnams gong bzhin la rkang gling g.yab dar bcas byas la/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe mdung dar dung pa gser skyems khur mi rnams dang / mchod dpon gyi ka to ra lta bu'i snod gcig tu ting phor nang mchod kyis gang ba gcig dang / khrag gis gang ba gsum/ dung chos su dri bzang gi chu blug pa rnams bcug la stan khebs lta bu'i khebs kyis bkab pa thogs gtor gdan stag gzig sogs kyi pags pa phrag par bkal/ de'i rjes su thog mar las gshin dang /

de nas drug cu pa'i gtor ma khur mi'i rjes rkang gling rnga rol/ 'bag pa zor las pa rnams gsum brdung gi ngang nas thon/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil bzhin pas thon/ 'chams ran pa dang / dril gsil bzhag 'di bzhin 'og ma kun la 'gre/ ji ltar rigs par gtor gdan gyi steng gtor ma rnams sgrigs/ dzam sngon 'gro'i bzhi 'gros ci rigs kyi slob dpon rol mo ba'i gral du 'ongs la sbraṃ sbraṃ mi the ba'i gsum brdung gnyis/ 'then rkang gnyis/ dgu brdung 'then rkang gnyis/ che gcig rnams byas la las gshin gyi bzlog pa/ chos kyi rgyal po'i dbyangs rol mo bya ba nas bzung bar gyi mthar bsgyur ro la tshig rol dgu brdung gi bar byas la/ rol mo gsum brdung gi ngang nas ji ltar rigs par phyin la/ slob dpon gyis 'chams rdzogs nas gral du slebs bstun sbraṃ sbraṃ mi the ba'i dgu brdung mthar 123byas la bzhag bzlog pa'i phros rgyal chen bzhi yis dgra yul du zhes sogs btang la gsum brdung gi ngang nas gtor ma brdeg sar slebs pa dang gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas la/ rnga rol bzhag nas slob dpon gyi gser skyems thogs la bdud rtsi byin brlabs rnga rol bcams la 'chams tshul dang / gser skyems shlau ka dang po gnyis la 'khril mchod ma'i dbyangs/ 'jam po'i 'khyil 'chams gsum brdeg len can/ sangs rgyas kun gyi nas 'dur shur gang rung / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod zer ba thams cad la tshig rol dgu brdung / rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis la tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar chems brdung byas la/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems nam mkha' sa steng sa 'og gsum du 'thor tshul byas la/ mthar rang gis kyang myangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang / sarba bighnan gatstsha zhes brjod/ gral du slebs nas rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ 123dgu brdung dang / 123byas la bzhag nas dpang gzugs kyi mthar tshig rol dgu brdung /

zor lam dbye ba la slob dpon kha phyir blta dang / g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rdo rjes zor lam dbye tshul/ bcol ba'i phrin las la tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar chems brdung skabs slob dpon gyis dril gsil rdo rje gsor ba dang bcas 'jigs byed dang / las gshin yab yum gyi sngags rnams bzla/ sa lo'i phyag len la gser skyems dpang gzugs zor lam dbye ba rnams gtong rim 'di bzhin mdzad pa gtor bzlog phar cher la rigs 'gre/ de nas sbraṃ sbraṃ mi the ba'i gsum brdeg gnyis/ 'then rkang gnyis/ dgu brdung sogs las gtad kyi rol dbyangs rnams byas la/ de dag gis theng brdung rnams la 'chams med/ dril bu gsil/ gsum brdeg 'then rkang dgu brdung rnams la 'chams bya/ las gtad kyi phrin las myur du gtad pa ni zhes rdzogs nas/ 'then brdung gi skabs slob dpon gyis gom 'gros dang / phyag mtshan g.yas g.yon du gsor ba dang bcas gtor ma dang nye bar phyin la phod brdzes sogs bde chas bya/ slob dpon 'gros kyi yong ba dang bstun mchod dpon gyi lcags mkhar dang las gshin gtor ma'i ba dan rnams bsdus/ gzhan rnams rol mo'i skabs slob dpon gyi gting phor gsum gyi khrag de/ las gshin gyi gtor mar rim bzhin blug pa dang bstun gzhung bzhin sngags brjod/ ting du nang mchod blug pa de dung chos kyi dri chu blug la rdo rje'i che dung chos kyi khog dri chu la ma reg tsam du btsugs/ oṃ badzra sogs lan bdun bzlas la/ rgyal po 'khor bcas sogs dang / 'di ni khyod kyi sogs brjod la gong gi sngags de brjod pa dang bstun las gshin gtor rtse nas lan gsum blug rdo rje thogs la rgyal po 'khor bcas nas sa ma ya tīṣṭa'i bar brjod/ de nas las gshin gyi gtor ma blangs la/ dzaṃ lan g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du gsor ba dang bcas chems brdung gi bar la las gshin gyi sngags kyi mthar/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje dam can chos kyi rgyal po/

srid gsum ma mo'i gtso mo 'chi bdag ma tsa munt+ri/ las kyi gshed bzhi/ sgrol ba'i gying bzhi/ bka' mnyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa dang / 'dir sku rim chen mo lta bu la rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung brgyud bu slob sbyin bdag lha sde mi sde chos srid dpal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhes sbyar de bzhin du mig bcas gang dgos rigs pas bsgyur/ spyir btang la dkyus bzhin/ khyed la gnyer du gtad pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod la sa la drag tu brdabs/ yang lcags mkhar thogs la dzaṃ lan g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gsor ba dang bcas pa grub nas chems brdung gi bar la phrag pa g.yas su 'phyar te/ 'jigs byed kyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams dang / oṃ bhā ya nā sa ni sogs bha ya na'i sngags dang / sum trika raksha bhyoḥ thib thib tsakra bhyoḥ snying kha rag dun tri bhyoḥ tri ṇa shig se na gtubs/ kha rag rbad/ dumbu bhyoḥ badzra ra ti raksha tsa turmā ra ya hūm̐/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ kyai srid gsum dregs pa'i dad dpon tshangs dbang / brgya byin/ me lha/ gshin rje/ srin po/ chu bdag rlung lha/ gnod sbyin/ dbang ldan/ sa la 'khor/ zhing skyong / ma mo/ mkha' 'gro la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs drag shugs can khyed rnams khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa zhes sogs las gshin gyi skabs ltar la khyed rnams la gnyer du gtad pa'i zhes sbyar lcags mkhar sa la drag tu brdabs/

sems 'dzin med kyi ngang las rdo rje gsor dril bu dkrol/ skad drag pos hrīḥṣṭīḥji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ mchod dpon gyi gru gsum bdun brtsegs rnams kyi srog shing bton/ slob dpon gyi brdab phod drag tu brdabs/ rang gi g.yon phyogs la kha bsgyur te gtor ma rgyag sa ngos la rgyab ston pa dang stabs bstun/ sgrub grogs rnams kyi rnga rol 'jog tshul ni/ rang re'i phyag len la/ 1234zhes pa 'di yin/ de nas slob dpon gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi/ sogs brjod pa dang bstun rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa gur me 'od dang bcas pa'i thun mong ba'i bsrung 'khor dang / rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i skye mched sku gsung thugs lha'i rang bzhin du bdag bskyed kyi skabs su bsgom pa de wal gyis dran par byas la rkang rjes rnams rdo rje rgya gram du lam lam gsal 'debs bzhin pas/ 'phrin las tsha zer las/ rang dang grogs rnams hrīḥṣṭīḥs srung / zhes gsungs pas/ hrīḥṣṭīḥbazlas kyang chog rang re'i phyag len la badzra raksha dang tshe gzungs bzlas bzhin pas sgrub khang du log pa yin pas de bzhin bya zhing / slob dpon gyi gzhug sdud byas nas sngon la mi 'gro/ de nas sgrub khang du slebs pa dang stan la 'khod/ gtor 'bul srid zhi dpal 'byor ma sogs bya skabs mchod dpon gyi bzlog dkyil gyi g.yas la/ chu gcig sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs 'bul tshul rnams gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar yin/ rol chen gyi bar la gzugs sgra sogs yid mchod bya/ 'grub na 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'don dgos pa ni/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags kyi 'jigs byed chos skor la dris pa'i rang lan dpyid kyi rgyal mo las/ 'di'i bstod yul ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sprul gzhi 'phags pa 'jam dpal nyid mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gi bsam nas gus 'dud byed pa yin la/

de'i dgos pa yang gtor ma tshar rjes su rgyab rten gyi rim 'gro bsod nams gsog cing / lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir rgyas pa na mtshan brjod rang 'don pa'am/ bsdu na 'dud nyi shu'i bstod pa bya ba 'di skabs su babs cing 'brel chags pa yin no/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las gnad 'di ni ha la nag po'i shog ril gsum gyi 'grel pa rgya ston rin po ches mdzad pa las phyi rol du dgra phyogs la gtor ma 'phangs tshar rjes nang du log nas sgrub khang du mtshan brjod 'don par gsungs pa dang mthun pas 'khrul pa med par sems sogs zhes gsungs pas na/ mchod rol rdzogs nas/ rgya gar skad du/ ārya sogs mtshan brjod tshar gcig bton la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can zhes sogs mjug chog tshang ma nyin snga ma rnams sor bzhag la/ oṃ khyed kyi sogs gshegs gsol gyi mthar oṃ badzra bhai ra wa sogs gshegs gsol gyi sngags rnams brjod la/ dkyil 'khor rdul tshon yin na mchod dpon gyis mtha' nas dbus su rim gyis bsdus/ thig rjes rnams chus bsrubs/ ras bris yin na gshegs gsol gyi sngags rgyas pa rnams brjod mi dgos/ bkra shis kyi skabs su bla ma yi dam chos bsrung nor lha'i bkra shis ci shes dang / 'di'i bkra shis 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sogs gur zhal gyi bkra shis rnams byas la/ me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /yang rgyun du bsgom bzlas byed na/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ gnas gsum dang skye mched bsrung / dge ba bsngo/ yang gtor bsngos chen mo'i bdag bskyed la len na sa lo'i phyag len la 'og nas mdun bskyed yod tshe mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs 'gro'i sngon du mdzad pas/ de'i tshul gnas yo byin brlabs sbrags ma ni/ ya manta ka dang / swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las sogs kyai rdor bzhin dang /

a las ye shes kyi kā pā la sogs 'phrin las tsha zer gyi mjug gi mchod pa byin brlabs bzhin la/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa sogs kyai rdor bzhin gyi mthar/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs chu gnyis byas kyang 'gal ba med/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar gyi bdag bskyed/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pa sogs bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod sor gzhag la/ 'jigs byed kyi gtor bsngos mchod pa la mtshan sngags gcig sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ dpon slob mang du yod na yid mchod dang / bstod thung phrin bcol rnams la dril gsil rol chen kyai rdor gtor bsngos bzhin bde kyai nas phur srung gtor bsngo'i bar bya/ de nas phyogs skyong gtor bsngo'i skabs bskyed chog dang phur gdab rgyas pa bya/ gtor ma phul mthar/ oṃ arghaṃ/ puṣpe nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar la phyag rgya nang mchod/ bstod pa 'phrin bcol la dril gsil las rol chen med/ las gshin dpa' gcig gtor bsngo'i mchod pa'i skabs g.yas sdigs mdzub kho na dang / g.yon gyi so so'i phyag rgya/ oṃ kā la ru pa gṛhṇe dyaṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du puṣpaṃ nas nai wi dya'i bar la'ang sbyar/ arghaṃ gyi 'go'i oṃ 'dis kyang chog 'chi bdag nag po sogs la dril gsil las rol chen med/ de nas spyi gtor gzhi bdag sogs phur srung gi bzlas pa rdzogs nas las gshin gyi sngags thung gnyis bzla/ 'jigs byed la mchod bstod ma byung kyang chog pas de phyin gtor bsngo chen mo sor bzhag go sku rim chen mo'i gnam gang gi nyin 'di bzhin bya zhing / bdag bskyed kyi bshags pa rnams phreng 'khor re dang las gshin kyi sngags thung gnyis gsum re/ mjug chog la yig brgya bzla ba sogs tshang ma gong ma rnams dang mthun zhing bkra shis mtshungs med bla ma sogs rgyun bzhin la skye med ma'i rjes la/
